name: AppLocker
author: AntHJ
description:
You can now Lock and Unlock access to your Vitas apps. Pressing X on your selected app will create a lock that is bypassable by a combo, Pressing Square will FULLY lock the app so it cannot be bypassed, and Pressing O will remove the app lock.
To bypass the lock : Hold the left analogue left, the right analogue right and press both L + R triggers all at the same time..
